scope.description: An opt-in ornamental-poster direction that places the user-selected subject inside a flowing frame and connects it to repeated curvilinear ornament, flat color fields, and optional typography without prescribing a person, flower, advertisement, or text.
limitations: Preserve the requested subject and count; do not add a woman, flowers, jewelry, a product, or a historical character unless requested.
Use an ornamental border only when the caller requests a poster or decorative panel; do not force it onto an ordinary scene.
Include lettering only when exact wording is supplied; never invent pseudo-text, brand names, signatures, or dates.
Build new framing and ornament; do not copy the layout or figure pose of a named Mucha work.

rules.instruction: Keep the user-selected subject as the first read; use a vertical arch, partial frame, or border rhythm only when it supports the requested poster layout, and leave the subject's contour unobstructed.
rules.observable: The subject reads before the ornament, while frame shapes connect the top, sides, or lower edge into a deliberate poster composition.
rules.reject_when: A decorative halo crowds the subject, framing becomes a copied layout, or the border dictates an unrequested portrait pose.
rules.avoid: mandatory round halos, obscured subject contours, and copied poster layouts

rules.applies_when: The requested poster benefits from decorative movement around its subject.
rules.instruction: Build a small family of flowing curves that echo the subject's contours and guide the eye through the composition; use botanical forms only when requested, otherwise keep the ornament abstract and shape-linked.
rules.observable: Ornament feels continuous with the subject's movement and varies in scale, with open gaps that prevent a dense wallpaper effect.
rules.reject_when: Repeated flowers, hair-like swirls, or arabesques appear without request, or ornament forms an independent texture layer.
rules.avoid: unsolicited flowers, hair swirls, jewelry, and dense wallpaper patterns

rules.instruction: Separate the subject, frame, and background with a restrained set of flat color areas; use warm paper and selective contour variation, with gentle modeling only where it clarifies the requested form.
rules.observable: Color blocks remain distinct, contours remain graceful, and texture is limited to a subtle printed surface rather than a global sepia filter.
rules.reject_when: Photographic lighting, metallic effects, or all-over grain overwhelms the flat poster structure.
rules.avoid: global sepia wash, photorealistic lighting, and heavy metallic effects

rules.applies_when: The user supplies exact poster wording or explicitly requests a blank title area.
rules.instruction: Reserve the requested text zone within the frame; reproduce only the exact supplied wording, or leave the zone blank when requested, with legible spacing that does not obscure the subject.
rules.observable: Lettering appears only when requested and its content is exact; otherwise the poster contains no text, logo, signature, or pseudo-lettering.
rules.reject_when: The model invents words, adds a trademark or artist signature, or uses decorative glyph-like marks that resemble text.
rules.avoid: pseudo-text, invented advertising copy, signatures, and logos

joint_checks.instruction: Align the subject silhouette, frame, color blocks, and any requested typography in one readable hierarchy; use ornament to connect the layout without adding unrequested content.
joint_checks.observable: The subject remains first read, decorative curves guide rather than cover it, and text is absent unless exact copy is supplied.
